name: Omen Tracker
author: Purachina
prompt:
### Omen Tracker
Track the signs the world plants ahead of events that are coming. Use this EXACT format:

[OMEN|Sign|Reading|Horizon]
context: MANDATORY; where the sign appeared and who noticed or missed it
[/OMEN]

Horizon options: 🌑 DISTANT | 🌓 APPROACHING | 🌕 IMMINENT | ☄ ARRIVED | 🕊 PASSED OVER

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content, on responses where an omen is PLANTED, ADVANCES, or RESOLVES.
- Write Reading as what the sign suggests. A Reading is allowed to be wrong, and characters are allowed to misread it.
- Resolve every planted omen eventually, as either ARRIVED or PASSED OVER. Both endings are valid.
- Keep omens proportionate to the scene and aimed at human-scale events.
- Print at most one OMEN block per response.

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 3 | separators and closing with ] on that same line, keeping every field a short phrase on that one line; start the next line with context: and keep the whole context on that single line; put the closing [/OMEN] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
